    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Gateway_StartPreparation" targetRef="Task_PrepareFood"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Gateway_StartPreparation" targetRef="Gateway_AlcoholChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Gateway_StartPreparation" targetRef="Task_PrepareCart"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Task_PrepareFood" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationsReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Gateway_AlcoholChoice" targetRef="Gateway_AlcoholItems">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${order.includesAlcoholicBeverages}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAlcohol" sourceRef="Gateway_AlcoholChoice" targetRef="Gateway_AlcoholMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Gateway_AlcoholItems" targetRef="Task_FetchWine">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${order.includesWine}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Gateway_AlcoholItems" targetRef="Task_PrepareOtherAlcohol">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${order.includesOtherAlcoholicBeverages}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_FetchWine" targetRef="Gateway_AlcoholItemsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_PrepareOtherAlcohol" targetRef="Gateway_AlcoholItemsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Gateway_AlcoholItemsJoin" targetRef="Gateway_AlcoholMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Gateway_AlcoholMerge" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationsReady"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_PrepareCart" targetRef="Task_PrepareNonalcoholicDrinks"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Task_PrepareNonalcoholicDrinks" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationsReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationsReady" targetRef="Task_DeliverOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Task_DeliverOrder" targetRef="Task_ReturnToStation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Task_ReturnToStation" targetRef="Gateway_BillingChoice"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingChoice" targetRef="Event_OtherOrderWorkComplete">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${anotherOrderToPrepareOrDeliver}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BillNow" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingChoice" targetRef="Gateway_BillingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_23" sourceRef="Event_OtherOrderWorkComplete" targetRef="Gateway_BillingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_24" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingMerge" targetRef="Task_DebitAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_25" sourceRef="Task_DebitAccount" targetRef="End_OrderComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/evanstonian/room-service">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RoomServiceCall" name="Room-service call"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_RoomService">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Guest" name="Guest"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Evanstonian" name="The Evanstonian" processRef="Process_RoomService"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_GuestCall" name="Room-service call" sourceRef="Participant_Guest" targetRef="Start_RoomServiceCall" messageRef="Message_RoomServiceCall"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Delivery" name="Order delivered" sourceRef="Task_DeliverOrder" targetRef="Participant_Guest"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_RoomService" name="Room-service order fulfillment" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_RoomService">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Manager" name="Room-service manager">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_RoomServiceCall</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TakeOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SubmitKitchenTicket</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_StartKitchenAndSommelierOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_OrderSommelier</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_StartSommelierWorkAndAssignWaiter</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssignWaiter</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Kitchen" name="Kitchen">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareFood</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Sommelier" name="Sommelier">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AlcoholChoice</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AlcoholItems</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FetchWine</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareOtherAlcohol</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AlcoholItemsJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AlcoholMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Waiter" name="Waiter">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_StartWaiterPreparation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareCart</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareNonalcoholicDrinks</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_WaiterPreparationJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PreparationsReady</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DeliverOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReturnToStation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_BillingChoice</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_OtherOrderWorkComplete</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_BillingMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DebitAccount</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_OrderComplete</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_RoomServiceCall" name="Guest calls room service">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_RoomServiceCall" messageRef="Message_RoomServiceCall"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TakeOrder" name="Take down order"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SubmitKitchenTicket" name="Submit order ticket to kitchen"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_StartKitchenAndSommelierOrder" name="Start kitchen preparation and sommelier order"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareFood" name="Prepare food"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_OrderSommelier" name="Give order to sommelier"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_StartSommelierWorkAndAssignWaiter" name="Start sommelier work and assign order to waiter"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AlcoholChoice" name="Does the order include alcoholic beverages?" default="Flow_NoAlcohol">
      <bpmn:documentation>About 80% of room-service orders include wine or another alcoholic beverage.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AlcoholItems" name="Select alcoholic beverages ordered"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FetchWine" name="Fetch wine from cellar"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareOtherAlcohol" name="Prepare other alcoholic beverages"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AlcoholItemsJoin" name="Alcoholic beverages ready"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AlcoholMerge" name="Continue after sommelier work"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_AssignWaiter" name="Assign order to waiter"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_StartWaiterPreparation" name="Prepare cart and nonalcoholic drinks"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareCart" name="Prepare cart with tablecloth and silverware"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareNonalcoholicDrinks" name="Prepare nonalcoholic drinks"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_WaiterPreparationJoin" name="Cart and nonalcoholic drinks ready"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationsReady" name="Food, beverages, and cart ready"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DeliverOrder" name="Deliver order to guest's room"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReturnToStation" name="Return to room-service station"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BillingChoice" name="Is there another order to prepare or deliver?" default="Flow_BillNow"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_OtherOrderWorkComplete" name="Other order work complete">
      <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalEventDefinition_OtherOrderWorkComplete">
        <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${otherOrderWorkComplete}</bpmn:condition>
      </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BillingMerge" name="Continue to billing"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DebitAccount" name="Debit guest's account"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_OrderComplete" name="Guest's account debited"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="Start_RoomServiceCall" targetRef="Task_TakeOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_TakeOrder" targetRef="Task_SubmitKitchenTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_SubmitKitchenTicket" targetRef="Gateway_StartKitchenAndSommelierOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Gateway_StartKitchenAndSommelierOrder" targetRef="Task_PrepareFood"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Gateway_StartKitchenAndSommelierOrder" targetRef="Task_OrderSommelier"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_OrderSommelier" targetRef="Gateway_StartSommelierWorkAndAssignWaiter"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Gateway_StartSommelierWorkAndAssignWaiter" targetRef="Gateway_AlcoholChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Gateway_StartSommelierWorkAndAssignWaiter" targetRef="Task_AssignWaiter"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Task_PrepareFood" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationsReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Gateway_AlcoholChoice" targetRef="Gateway_AlcoholItems">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${order.includesAlcoholicBeverages}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAlcohol" sourceRef="Gateway_AlcoholChoice" targetRef="Gateway_AlcoholMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Gateway_AlcoholItems" targetRef="Task_FetchWine">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${order.includesWine}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Gateway_AlcoholItems" targetRef="Task_PrepareOtherAlcohol">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${order.includesOtherAlcoholicBeverages}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_FetchWine" targetRef="Gateway_AlcoholItemsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_PrepareOtherAlcohol" targetRef="Gateway_AlcoholItemsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Gateway_AlcoholItemsJoin" targetRef="Gateway_AlcoholMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Gateway_AlcoholMerge" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationsReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_AssignWaiter" targetRef="Gateway_StartWaiterPreparation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Gateway_StartWaiterPreparation" targetRef="Task_PrepareCart"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Gateway_StartWaiterPreparation" targetRef="Task_PrepareNonalcoholicDrinks"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Task_PrepareCart" targetRef="Gateway_WaiterPreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Task_PrepareNonalcoholicDrinks" targetRef="Gateway_WaiterPreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Gateway_WaiterPreparationJoin" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationsReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_23" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationsReady" targetRef="Task_DeliverOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_24" sourceRef="Task_DeliverOrder" targetRef="Task_ReturnToStation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_25" sourceRef="Task_ReturnToStation" targetRef="Gateway_BillingChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_26" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingChoice" targetRef="Event_OtherOrderWorkComplete">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${anotherOrderToPrepareOrDeliver}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BillNow" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingChoice" targetRef="Gateway_BillingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_27" sourceRef="Event_OtherOrderWorkComplete" targetRef="Gateway_BillingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_28" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingMerge" targetRef="Task_DebitAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_29" sourceRef="Task_DebitAccount" targetRef="End_OrderComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description says that a participant performs work by sending information to another participant: Model the sending as a task (use a send task when sending is itself the unit of work). Represent communication separately where appropriate; do not attach a message event definition to a task.
rules.situation: the description says that a participant performs work by sending information to another participant

rules.instruction: When the description identifies multiple independent activities that must all be completed before a later activity can begin: model the activities as parallel branches and synchronize them with a parallel join before the later activity
rules.situation: the description states that an activity occurs while other independent activities are underway, and a later activity depends on all of them being complete

rules.instruction: When the description distinguishes a participant’s instruction or assignment from the work that another participant is asked to perform: Label the BPMN activity as the instruction or assignment, preserving who directs whom; do not label it as though the directing participant were ordering or performing the requested work.
rules.situation: the description distinguishes a participant’s instruction or assignment from the work that another participant is asked to perform

rules.instruction: When the description states that a distinct activity is performed while other activities are in progress and that a later activity depends on their completion: Model the distinct activity and the other required work on concurrent branches, then synchronize those branches before the dependent activity.
rules.situation: the description states that a distinct activity is performed while other activities are in progress and that a later activity depends on their completion

rules.instruction: When the description explicitly identifies who performs an activity: Use a concise BPMN activity label that preserves the stated performer as well as the action, when needed to distinguish whose action it is.
rules.situation: the description explicitly identifies who performs an activity
